text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh! My forehead is breaking out way too 
much... Has that facial cleanser I ordered 
not arrived yet?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What!? Why did you go to Europe!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Even airmail runs into this kind 
of trouble, doesn't it. I'll have to think 
of another way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
First, cover it with concealer— What!? 
There's another cut over here?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to get her favorite facial 
cleanser, Daring Heart continued to suffer 
from rough skin...
